           3. ELECTION OF OFFICERS:

              The bylaws state that no officer can serve more than two consecutive terms in the same office. The
              terms are one year each and both Greg Kruskamp and Toby Bordewyk’s are now ineligible to serve as
              Chairman and Vice chair respectively.
